part.text:
The problem:

text in index.html does not match meta.json description. We need to examine index.html line for description to update it to match meta.json description exactly, or edit meta.json to match description. Choose easiest: edit index.html description to match meta.json description. The description string in meta.json is: "Ride a dot along a sinusoidal tunnel as it automatically advances. Tap or click to flip the wave’s phase and line up peaks and troughs with gaps to survive." Check index.html description line: line 21: "

Ride a dot along a sinuous tunnel as it auto‑advances. Tap to flip the wave’s phase and line up peaks and troughs with gaps to survive.

" So there are differences: "sinuous tunnel" vs "sinusoidal tunnel"; "auto‑advances" vs "automatically advances"; "Tap to flip" vs "Tap or click to flip". Also meta includes "or click". Also string uses different apostrophe for wave’s might be same. Thus we need to update description in index.html to match meta.json exactly, including the capitalizations and punctuation. meta description: "Ride a dot along a sinusoidal tunnel as it automatically advances. Tap or click to flip the wave’s phase and line up peaks and troughs with gaps to survive." Thus we need to edit index.html line containing 'p class="game-description"' to the exact string. Let's open index.html lines around description to edit.

input.oldString: Ride a dot along a sinuous tunnel as it auto‑advances. Tap to flip the wave’s phase and line up peaks and troughs with gaps to survive.
input.newString: Ride a dot along a sinusoidal tunnel as it automatically advances. Tap or click to flip the wave’s phase and line up peaks and troughs with gaps to survive.
